description: Agent Supra supervision. Each hook runs the agent-supra command when it is installed; without it, the session start says how to install it and the other hooks do nothing.

hooks.command: if command -v agent-supra >/dev/null 2>&1; then agent-supra claude-hook; else printf '%s\n' '{"systemMessage":"Agent Supra: the agent-supra command is not installed on this computer, so this session is not supervised. Install it with: curl -fsSL https://agentsupra.in/install.sh | sh   (Windows PowerShell: irm https://agentsupra.in/install.ps1 | iex), then start a new session.","hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"The Agent Supra plugin is enabled but the agent-supra command is not installed, so this session is not supervised. If the user asks about Agent Supra, tell them to run the installer from https://agentsupra.in/docs/quickstart and start a new session."}}'; fi
